C0992.title: Friend Borrowed Game Account, $80K Virtual Assets Frozen — Court Rules on Liability
C0992.summary: In March 2024, Wang lent his game account to friend Meng, who used prohibited third-party cheats, resulting in a permanent ban and the loss of over 80,000 yuan in virtual equipment and items.
